description: Understand what your threads cost in tokens and time, so you can cut what isn't worth it. Each thread's header shows a sparkline of its token use that opens a summary of which of your messages used the most tokens and time. Once a thread's context passes a size you set, a meter above the composer offers to compact it, and the sidebar counts those threads. A Tokenomics page charts tokens by hour or day, shows where turn time went, and ranks threads by use. Requires bb 0.43 or later, and counts Claude Code subagents only for threads that ran on the same machine as bb.
